We evaluate on six high-quality datasets across three core VL tasks: VQAv2, VizWiz, and OK-VQA for open-ended VQA; Flickr30K and MSCOCO for captioning; and HatefulMemes for classification.
In this work, we mainly focus on ICL for image-to-text tasks, where ICL sequences are organized in an interleaved image-text format.

For the VQA tasks, Hybrid dataset and tasks in VL-ICL Bench, we use accuracy as the metric ... CIDEr (Vedantam et al., 2015) is used for image captioning datasets (Flickr30k, MSCOCO). ROC-AUC is used for the HatefulMemes classification task.
For the image captioning tasks, we use the CIDEr score, which measures the similarity between generated captions and human annotations.
